items.text: Create a modern looking website with an interactive set of exercises to practice Czech noun declensions. Create the paradigms for two models for each gender, for each paradigm come up with a set of 10 most common nouns and create exercises of three types: multiple choice, cloze and drag and drop. Also generate a set of 3 short beginner level texts and 3 simple dialogues that can be linked to the practice exercises. Make the whole site and individual exercises embeddable in other sites such as a virtual learning environment or a blog. Make sure each exercise has an answer key and gives comprehensive feedback to the user. Make it possible for users to store progress and return to the site later to continue their learning.
